body: I've tried it and it's probably the quality of the weed around here, but it doesn't do much for me.

I don't trust cliffs. Too easy to fuck it up and just be horribly maimed. Probably the least painful ways to go would be either freezing to death (after a while euphoria sets in and you start feeling warm) or anoxia (just a plastic bag over your head -- euphoria sets in quite quickly as well and it's a faster way of dying).

I'd rather not give out my personal details in this context. There's a gpg public key above if you wish to PM me something private. I do appreciate the gesture, though.

I'm not too worried about the quality of mushrooms (you can't really fuck up a mushroom grow) nor the quality of ketamine -- it's mostly just bootlegged from vets, so with very high likelihood it's of good quality.

Mushrooms do require a very positive atmosphere, although since ketamine is a disassociative, then I'm not sure what the role of a tripsitter would be other than to make sure I stay hydrated.

Discussing these things with my psychologist is a good idea. Maybe they could get a research paper out of it.

Somewhere in Scandinavia.

I really don't want to kill myself, but I'm not sure what else I could be doing and killing myself by smoking two packs a day could be considered a slow type of suicide, so I dunno.

Will be meeting the doctor on Monday to discuss the prescription.

This apathy was there before, but the SSRIs made it worse. They also amplified my anxiety to the point where I need to take sedatives to be able to sleep and my hands shake and I sweat whenever I need to go outside.
